name: Librum SE
summary:
Librum for Skyrim Special Edition (SE) is a comprehensive gameplay, graphics, and content overhaul that reimagines the Skyrim experience as a hardcore survival-adventure game in a darker, more unforgiving world.
It combines some of the best and most popular mods for Skyrim SE, featuring a suite of new quests and adventures that outnumber the original game’s content.
The modlist completely overhauls mechanics, graphics, and atmosphere, integrating thousands of hours of new, fully voiced content into a cohesive vision.
